notes:
**CHR-1257, Stitch Board (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** Same read-only model as CHR-1260, drawn on the Stitch Board (`board-cluster`s on the dotted workspace). The text toolbar is gone; the controls are icon-only tools in the Board's `tool-bar`:
- **Comments** (`comments-header`, chat bubble, M): on = `pressed`, pins and chips show on the clusters; off (→ `board-view`) = `badge` with the open count, no markers. This replaces `board-toggle` "Comments: On / Off".
- **Show resolved** (`toolbar-side-show-resolved`, `task_alt`): off by default, `pressed` adds the grey resolved pins; `disabled` while Comments is off. This replaces `board-toggle` "Show resolved".
- **Comment** (`toolbar-side-comment`, C) is `disabled` on the Board, its label says why: comments are written in the Screens view.
Count chips sit in each cluster's name bar (`comment-count-chip`), never in the top-right corner, which belongs to the teal pin toggle. The Agent bar stays open.

---
**Board comments, default state** (CHR-1260 / CHR-1261, direction A1, click to read). The Board shows a screen's comment threads **read-only**. Reply, resolve and re-anchor stay in the Screens view.

**What is on a tile**
- `comment-pin` per open thread, centred on the anchored element's top-right corner, scaled with the tile (same rule as the canvas). Human blue, agent violet.
- Pins that would overlap at the current zoom merge into `comment-pin` variant `group` (dark pill with the count, aria-label "N comments overlap here, zoom in to separate them"). A click on a group zooms the Board to that tile; it never opens a preview.
- Detached threads: `comment-pin` variant `detached` stacked at the frame's **top-left** corner.
- Name bar: `comment-count-chip` (open count), `detached` chip when any thread lost its node, `resolved` chip (grey, check) while Show resolved is off and the screen only has resolved threads ("2 resolved, hidden").
- **Clear of the teal pin button:** the `pin-button` keeps the tile's top-right corner. Comment markers never sit there: chips live in the name bar, detached pins top-left, element pins on the thumbnail.

**Toolbar:** *(superseded by the CHR-1257 tools above)* "Comments: On" hides every comment marker when off. "Show resolved" (off by default) adds grey resolved pins. The status adds "N open comments · N detached" for the shown screens.

**Interaction:** hover does nothing beyond the pointer cursor and the native focus ring. There is no hover preview, decided by Christian. A **click** (or Enter/Space on a focused pin) opens the read-only preview → `board-comments-preview`. A detached pin opens the detached preview → `board-comments-detached`. A click on the tile itself still opens the screen.

**A11y:** pins are `<button>`s in DOM order per tile (tile → its pins → next tile). aria-label "Comment N on <node>, open|resolved|detached", `aria-expanded` false/true, `aria-controls` the preview's id. Chips are buttons with full-sentence aria-labels; colour is never the only carrier (icons + numbers).
